final_message:
I've built the June recap workbook. It has the two summary tables (filterable by account), PO-level support tabs and the short write-up. I recalculated the per-account formulas separately and they match the figures below.

**June shipped (Table 1):** 48 POs shipped between 6/1/25 and 6/30/25, totaling **$140,008.20 at cost**. Those POs were ordered at **$145,218.80**, so 96.4% shipped and **$5,210.60 was short-shipped**. Thread Up ($2,263.05) and Sigma ($1,533.31) account for most of the shortfall.

**June orders that slipped to July (Table 2):** 5 POs had both their ship start and cancel dates in June but didn't ship until 7/1/25. They total **$13,300.00 at cost**, of which $13,248.00 shipped.
- By account: Marchand $4,700, Thread Up $3,900, Sigma $2,600, Pronto $2,100.
- Had they shipped on time, June would have been about $153,256, so June came in 8.6% lower.
- All 5 shipped after their cancel dates, so it's worth confirming extensions or possible chargebacks with those accounts.

**Assumptions:**
- **Only one input file:** the workspace and attachments folders didn't exist, so there was no registry or draft to check. I used `PO Log.xlsx` as the official record.
- **"Shipped" means already shipped:** every PO in the log has status "Shipped", so the 5 "slated for July" orders have in fact already left the warehouse on 7/1.
- **What counts as June:** any PO that physically shipped in June is included, even if its window was in May or it shipped early.
- **What I left out of Table 2:** 11 more POs ($30,334.40) started their window in June but had July cancel dates, so they fall outside the definition you gave. I listed them as a watch list on the notes tab instead.

**Data issues flagged in the workbook (none change the June totals):**
- 9 POs with May cancel dates shipped on 6/2.
- 4 POs shipped after their cancel date within June.
- 7 POs shipped before their ship start date.
- 3 POs are marked "Shipped" but have ship dates after today (7/7).
- POs 6349678 and 8452922 (Five O Fore) have identical order and shipped values, so they may be duplicates. Both are included.

DONE

Files are in `outputs/`:
- `June_2025_Shipment_Recap.xlsx`
